Date: June 10, 1992

Steps to find the day of the week:

 
 

 
 
Last two digit of year

 
 
 
92

 
 
 

 
 
No. of leap year (divisor)

 
 
 
92 ÷ 4

 
Divisor = 23

 
 
 

 
 
Code of the month

 
 
 
5

 
 
 

 
 
Date

 
 
 
10

 
 
 

Total = (92 + 23 + 5 + 10) = 130

And 130 ÷ 7, we get 4 as the remainder.
